parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the scaling group.

parameters.name: heartbeatTimeout
parameters.description:
The wait time that the lifecycle hook sets for the scaling group activity. After the wait state times out, the default policy is executed. Valid values: 30 to 21600. Unit: seconds.

After a lifecycle hook is created, you can call this operation to extend the wait time of the ECS instance, or call [CompleteLifecycleAction](~~73847~~) to end the wait state of the scaling activity in advance.

Default value: 600.

parameters.name: lifecycleActionToken
parameters.description:
The token that indicates the wait state of the scaling activity. You can obtain this token from the details of the message received from the Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) queue specified by the lifecycle hook when the instance is in the suspended state.

You can also call [DescribeLifecycleActions](~~202473~~) to obtain this token.

Alternatively, you can obtain this value from the Simple Message Queue (formerly MNS) topic specified by the lifecycle hook.

parameters.name: lifecycleHookId
parameters.description: The ID of the lifecycle hook.
